page.layout: One column of text, with question-and-answer paragraphs. No marginal notes. Catchword and signature at the bottom right.

main_text.p: I. Quid ex resurrectione Christi nobis utilitatis accedit?

R. Efficit in nobis ut in novam vitam a peccatis resurgamus, & in novitate vitae ambulemus. Deinde firmat in nobis spem immortalitatis, credimus enim per Christum resuscitari corpora nostra ad vitam aeternam.
I. Quid utilitatis nobis ex ascensione Christi est?
R. Christus suo ascensu aditu nobis regni coelorum aperuit. Inde iubemur redemptorē nostrum expectare ad diem illum. Hoc docet nos vigilare, ut stemus in timore Dei & innocenter viuamus.
R. Coetus omnium piorum qui Christo fidunt, & novitati vitae student.
R. Solus Deus per sanguinem Christi.

page.notes: The first letter of the catchword, and the signature mark, are only roughly legible. The scan shows the signature "L." followed by a catchword that could read "Wars" or "Warz". The page is mostly clear. "uiuamus" was read as "viuamus" as printed; the spelling of u/v was normalised as instructed.
